text:
sarah: Heads up - us-west2 cluster: tiny model jobs piling on a handful of racks, preempt storms yesterday night.
leo: Saw that. Eviction spikes align with our new rack-shield taint. Small pods can't escape because affinity targets 'rack:gold' only.
maria: Also noticing attach detach jitter on warmpools in us-west2b, p50 200ms -> p95 3s. Could be conntrack + node egress NAT.
sarah: Agreed. The scheduler's latebind plus our NVLink constraint is making us prefer same-rack, creating micro-fragmentation.
ops-bot: Alert: pod_eviction_rate_us-west2 > 0.6% (rolling 15m)
leo: Proposal: create a short-lived relaxer that removes rack hard-affinity for pods with label `rlx/binpack=true` and toleration `taint/rack-shield:NoSchedule` for 30m.
maria: Can we scope to only high-priority tiny-gangs? We don't want big model jobs losing NVLink locality.
sarah: yes - add selector `pod.spec.metadata.annotations['infra/binpack-scope']='tiny-gang'`. Only those will be eligible.
tony: Also, reduce warmpool attach timeout from 25s -> 10s to free up nodes faster. Risk: might increase churn on coldstarts.
leo: I'll run a local binpack sim with the last 12h to estimate egress delta. If cross-rack increases egress cost > 8% revert.
maria: How to roll this? Manual patch to scheduler-configmap then rollout a canary scheduler deployment in us-west2a only.
sarah: Command I will run: ```kubectl patch configmap scheduler-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"enable_temporary_relax":"true","relax_duration":"30m","attach_timeout":"10s"}}'```
ops-bot: Runbook check: patch requires CI green + oncall approval.
tony: Oncall approved. CI green on latest commit.
leo: Canary deploy started in us-west2a. Watching p99 schedule latency and eviction-rate.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by leo at 1765566820. Metric monitoring started.
sarah: 7m update: p99 scheduler latency down 40%, evictions down 0.5% -> 0.1%. No regressed model jobs seen.
maria: binpack sim shows egress up ~2.3% for affected traffic, well under threshold.
tony: Ok keep for 1h and then either promote or rollback. Create a follow-up ticket to fix label rollout gating and warmpool sizing.
ops-bot: Ticket created: SCHED-4820 by sarah.
